title: Paul Whitehouse urges PM to act over ‘imminent extinction’ of Windermere’s ice-age fish
summary: Experts say arctic char is threatened by pollution in England’s biggest lake as comedian unveils sculpture

blocks.text:
Experts say arctic char is threatened by pollution in England’s biggest lake as comedian unveils sculpture

  • UK politics live – latest updates

An ancient fish species that has survived in Windermere for more than 11,000 years is at risk of “imminent” extinction due to widespread pollution in England’s biggest lake, experts have warned.

New research reveals the arctic char (or charr) appears to have disappeared from large parts of the 11-mile long lake where its habitats have been eroded by sewage and other substances.
